segments.an6.112:1.5: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
segments.an6.112:1.7: Assādadiṭṭhiyā pahānāya aniccasaññā bhāvetabbā, attānudiṭṭhiyā pahānāya anattasaññā bhāvetabbā, micchādiṭṭhiyā pahānāya sammādiṭṭhi bhāvetabbā.
segments.an6.112:1.8: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.

lines: Sammādiṭṭhīti maggasammādiṭṭhi, natthi dinnantiādikā vā micchādiṭṭhi, kammassakatañāṇaṃ sammādiṭṭhi.
